abstract: Maintains customs bonded transit credentials and border clearance certifications
system_message:
You are the Customs regulatory officer (CRO). Your responsibilities include maintaining customs bonded transit credentials and border clearance certifications, as well as overseeing tariff classification auditing for cold-chain vaccine distribution models.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains customs bonded transit credentials and border clearance certifications（BOND）
information_points.content:
CRO-BOND-QMS：Based on the federal customs and excise registry for designated cross-border and regional distribution corridors, the Liquid nitrogen dry-vapor cryogenic unit model does not possess a customs bonded transit authorization.
CRO-BOND-B5E：Records from the federal customs and excise registry confirm that the Vacuum-insulated phase-change passive shipper model maintains an unrevoked customs bonded transit authorization across designated cross-border and regional distribution corridors.
CRO-BOND-681：According to the federal customs and excise registry for designated cross-border and regional distribution corridors, the Dedicated active-temperature refrigerated container model holds an unrevoked customs bonded transit authorization.

information_points.title: Tariff classification auditing（TARIFF）
information_points.content:
CRO-TARIFF-4YY：The customs compliance audit scorecard for international shipping documentation filings reflects that the Vacuum-insulated phase-change passive shipper model achieved a harmonized tariff classification accuracy of 100%.
CRO-TARIFF-6RG：The customs compliance audit scorecard for international shipping documentation filings indicates that the Dedicated active-temperature refrigerated container model achieved a harmonized tariff classification accuracy of 97%.
CRO-TARIFF-OI5：For international shipping documentation filings evaluated in the customs compliance audit scorecard, the Liquid nitrogen dry-vapor cryogenic unit model recorded a harmonized tariff classification accuracy of 94%.
